props:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: modular original outdoor game PROP ATLAS for The Fading Kingdom. Square1536x1536PNG, exactly4columns x4rows, each384x384 cell. One isolated object per cell, entire object within its own cell with at least28px clear padding. TRUE TRANSPARENT background between and around objects, no cast shadows. No text, labels, grid lines or borders.
Reference image is the existing cottage, STYLE reference only: warm storybook pixel art, earthy palette, crisp warm brown outlines, tactile restrained shading, visible stepped pixel clusters. Do not reproduce the cottage. Do not draw any people or faces. Preserve a consistent overhead RPG view: see the top and front of props, vertical axes and horizontal fronts, no isometric diagonal footprints, no vanishing point. Match the cottage's light from upper left, simple4or5 shade ramps, no blur or smooth painting. Readable small game objects for a32-world-pixel-tall character. Each object centred; its base near cell bottom.
Exact row-major content:
Row1: column1 a rounded leafy oak tree with visible brown trunk and broad sage/moss canopy; column2 a taller narrow evergreen pine with visible trunk; column3 a rustic empty wooden bench facing viewer; column4 a small closed wooden storage chest with muted gold latch.
Row2: column1 straight horizontal rustic timber fence segment with TWO upright posts and TWO horizontal rails; column2 vertical north-south rustic fence segment seen from above, two posts along the vertical screen axis; column3 a matching open wooden garden gate, clear walkable opening between two posts; column4 small standing lantern on a wooden post, warm pale glass, daytime unlit.
Row3: column1 single small carrot seedling with2leaves and little soil tuft; column2 single growing carrot top with5leaves, no mature orange root; column3 single mature carrot with leafy top and partially visible orange root; column4 small clump of cream daisies and muted yellow flowers.
Row4: column1 fallen short tree log, horizontal, visible circular cut end; column2 small rounded grey-green boulder; column3 wooden planter box with leafy herbs and tiny cream flowers; column4 small low round old stone well with simple wooden crossbeam and bucket, no roof.
No surrounding scenery, ground platforms, grass squares, extra objects or decorative panels. No giant shadows, gradients, watermarks, characters, icons or text. Objects must be visually separate with empty gutters, consistent original chunky storybook pixel rendering. This atlas will be cropped into individual reusable sprites.
terrain: Create a production texture atlas for a cozy overhead farming RPG. EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows of square texture swatches, no gaps, no borders, no labels, no objects. Top left: quiet warm olive meadow grass, tiny subtle pixel clumps. Top right: warm sandy beige compacted footpath soil with sparse tiny pebbles. Bottom left: rich warm brown tilled earth, subtle short horizontal furrows. Bottom right: weathered grey beige small courtyard stone pavers, overhead horizontal and vertical layout. Each quadrant fully filled and with nearly uniform tone at its outer edges so repeated squares are unobtrusive. Restrained low contrast texture, no lighting gradients, no isolated landscaping, no perspective, no shadows, no characters. Chunky clear pixel clusters with warm storybook rustic colors matching the supplied cottage. 1024x1024 atlas, four 512 square cells. These are ground materials that must sit quietly below original expressive character sprites.
